relationships.subject: intravenous lidocaine
relationships.evidence_quote: Intravenous lidocaine alleviated mechanical allodynia and thermal hypoalgesia, downregulated the expression of TNF-α and IL-1β, and inhibited the activation of microglia and astrocytes in SDH.

relationships.subject: intravenous lidocaine
relationships.evidence_quote: Compared with the RTX + saline group, the activation of microglia in the RTX + lidocaine group was decreased

relationships.subject: intravenous lidocaine
relationships.evidence_quote: the activation of astrocyte in the RTX + lidocaine decreased in the ACC

key_findings: Intravenous lidocaine relieved mechanical allodynia and thermal hypoalgesia in PHN rats and reduced spinal TNF-α and IL-1β
Lidocaine inhibited astrocyte but not microglial activation in PFC, ACC and hippocampus and did not relieve anxiety/depressive-like behaviors
